title: How do I know if my child no longer needs occupational therapy?
metaTitle: Deciding When to Discontinue Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand when it might be the right time for your child to discontinue occupational therapy with insights from Pinnacle Blooms Network’s team of dedicated and skilled therapists.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand the emotional essence of this question. The decision to cease therapy is a significant one, and is taken on a collaborative basis. It involves you as parents, and our dedicated therapists. When your child has successfully met their therapy goals and can efficiently handle their daily activities, it may be the right time to consider discontinuing therapy. But remember, we’re always here to discuss and guide you through this progression.
